The save-side stamp targeted the wrong member.

## Server

### Fixed
- The player-record save stamp now writes the record struct's actual id member, which is Blueprint-mangled (`PlayerID_9_...`), not the plain `PlayerID` name. Every earlier stamp reported success because the table write did not fail, while the game kept saving the record under the blank id it received from the client. That is why a player's record was overwritten with the blank id after each session and the next join found nothing under their id. The readback now goes through a fresh parameter get so the log shows what the callee will actually see.
